figs.name: types-of-pressure-transmitters-sensing-reference-diagram
figs.alt: types of pressure transmitters gauge, absolute, differential and multivariable sensing references
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the four types of pressure transmitters and what each sensing diaphragm is referenced to: atmosphere, vacuum, LP port or several sensors.
figs.after_h2: Comparison of the Four Types of Pressure Transmitters
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Sensing references of gauge, absolute, differential and multivariable pressure transmitters</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Four Types of Pressure Transmitters</text>
<rect x="20" y="58" width="370" height="240" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="205" y="90" font-size="22" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Gauge</text>
<text x="205" y="118" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">reference: atmosphere</text>
<rect x="130" y="148" width="150" height="90" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="210" y="156" width="62" height="74" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<path d="M205 154 Q218 193 205 232" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="4"/>
<line x1="50" y1="193" x2="126" y2="193" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="85" y="178" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="end" text-anchor="middle">process</text>
<line x1="280" y1="193" x2="330" y2="193" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="330" y="178" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="end" text-anchor="middle">vent</text>
<text x="205" y="268" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">reads 0 at atmosphere</text>
<rect x="410" y="58" width="370" height="240" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="595" y="90" font-size="22" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Absolute</text>
<text x="595" y="118" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">reference: sealed vacuum</text>
<rect x="520" y="148" width="150" height="90" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="600" y="156" width="62" height="74" rx="6" fill="#e5e7eb" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<path d="M595 154 Q608 193 595 232" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="4"/>
<line x1="440" y1="193" x2="516" y2="193" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="475" y="178" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="end" text-anchor="middle">process</text>
<text x="680" y="188" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">sealed</text>
<text x="680" y="210" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">vacuum</text>
<text x="595" y="268" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">weather and altitude proof</text>
<rect x="20" y="313" width="370" height="240" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="205" y="345" font-size="22" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Differential</text>
<text x="205" y="373" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">HP minus LP</text>
<rect x="130" y="403" width="150" height="90" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="210" y="411" width="62" height="74" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<path d="M205 409 Q218 448 205 487" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="4"/>
<line x1="50" y1="448" x2="126" y2="448" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="85" y="433" font-size="18" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="end" text-anchor="middle">HP</text>
<line x1="350" y1="448" x2="284" y2="448" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="330" y="433" font-size="18" fill="#2563eb" font-weight="end" text-anchor="middle">LP</text>
<text x="205" y="523" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">flow, level, filter drop</text>
<rect x="410" y="313" width="370" height="240" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="595" y="345" font-size="22" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Multivariable</text>
<text x="595" y="373" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">DP, static P and temperature</text>
<rect x="430" y="393" width="110" height="40" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="485.0" y="418.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DP</text>
<line x1="542" y1="413" x2="585" y2="441" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="430" y="441" width="110" height="40" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="485.0" y="466.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Static P</text>
<line x1="542" y1="461" x2="585" y2="461" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="430" y="489" width="110" height="40" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="485.0" y="514.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Temp</text>
<line x1="542" y1="509" x2="585" y2="481" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="588" y="431" width="170" height="60" rx="10" fill="#15803d" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="673.0" y="455.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Microprocessor</text>
<text x="673.0" y="478.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">compensates</text>
<text x="673" y="523" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">mass and energy flow</text>
</svg>

figs.name: types-of-pressure-transmitters-gauge-absolute-chart
figs.alt: gauge vs absolute pressure chart with 6 bar gauge pump discharge example
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing gauge pressure measured from atmosphere and absolute pressure measured from perfect vacuum, using the 6 bar pump discharge example.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Gauge and absolute pressure scale with atmospheric pressure and perfect vacuum reference</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Gauge vs Absolute Pressure Reference</text>
<line x1="330" y1="470" x2="330" y2="70" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="310" y1="470" x2="760" y2="470" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="300" y="476" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Perfect vacuum</text>
<text x="300" y="500" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">0 bar absolute</text>
<line x1="310" y1="400" x2="760" y2="400" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/>
<text x="300" y="406" font-size="18" fill="#2563eb" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Atmosphere</text>
<text x="300" y="430" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">about 1.013 bar abs</text>
<line x1="310" y1="110" x2="760" y2="110" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="300" y="116" font-size="18" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Pump discharge</text>
<line x1="430" y1="400" x2="430" y2="114" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="445" y="250" font-size="19" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">6 bar gauge</text>
<text x="445" y="276" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">measured from</text>
<text x="445" y="298" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">atmosphere</text>
<line x1="580" y1="470" x2="580" y2="114" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="595" y="250" font-size="19" fill="#6d28d9" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">about 7 bar</text>
<text x="595" y="276" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">absolute, from</text>
<text x="595" y="298" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">vacuum</text>
<rect x="30" y="150" width="250" height="150" rx="12" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="155" y="184" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Absolute =</text>
<text x="155" y="212" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">gauge + atmospheric</text>
<text x="155" y="248" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">6 + 1.013</text>
<text x="155" y="276" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">= 7.013 bar abs</text>
<text x="420" y="525" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Below the atmosphere line a gauge transmitter reads vacuum.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: types-of-pressure-transmitters-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to select gauge, absolute, differential or multivariable pressure transmitter
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to choose between gauge, absolute, differential and multivariable pressure transmitters, followed by the selection checks from the article.
figs.after_h2: Key Points to Consider While Selecting a Pressure Transmitter
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to select a gauge, absolute, differential or multivariable pressure transmitter</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Which Pressure Transmitter Do You Need?</text>
<polygon points="230,57.0 395.0,100 230,143.0 65.0,100" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230" y="95.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pressure relative</text>
<text x="230" y="116.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">to atmosphere?</text>
<line x1="395" y1="100" x2="470" y2="100" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="432" y="90" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="470" y="67" width="210" height="66" rx="10" fill="#15803d" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="575.0" y="94.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Gauge</text>
<text x="575.0" y="117.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">pumps, water, air</text>
<line x1="230" y1="143" x2="230" y2="157" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="250" y="156" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="230,157.0 395.0,200 230,243.0 65.0,200" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230" y="195.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">True pressure or</text>
<text x="230" y="216.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">vacuum needed?</text>
<line x1="395" y1="200" x2="470" y2="200" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="432" y="190" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="470" y="167" width="210" height="66" rx="10" fill="#14532d" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="575.0" y="194.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Absolute</text>
<text x="575.0" y="217.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">vacuum, barometric</text>
<line x1="230" y1="243" x2="230" y2="257" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="250" y="256" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="230,257.0 395.0,300 230,343.0 65.0,300" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230" y="295.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Difference between</text>
<text x="230" y="316.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">two points?</text>
<line x1="395" y1="300" x2="470" y2="300" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="432" y="290" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="470" y="267" width="210" height="66" rx="10" fill="#15803d" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="575.0" y="294.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Differential</text>
<text x="575.0" y="317.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">flow, level, filter</text>
<line x1="230" y1="343" x2="230" y2="357" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="250" y="356" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="230,357.0 395.0,400 230,443.0 65.0,400" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230" y="395.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Compensated mass or</text>
<text x="230" y="416.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">energy flow?</text>
<line x1="395" y1="400" x2="470" y2="400" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="432" y="390" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="470" y="367" width="210" height="66" rx="10" fill="#14532d" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="575.0" y="394.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Multivariable</text>
<text x="575.0" y="417.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">steam, gas, energy</text>
<rect x="30" y="470" width="740" height="112" rx="12" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="498" font-size="18" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Then check for every type:</text>
<text x="400" y="526" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">pressure range, process temperature, fluid, accuracy, response,</text>
<text x="400" y="552" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">vibration and humidity, hazardous area, output signal and protocol</text>
</svg>
